editor_notes_for_email: Shipped below the art floor at the five-round cap: total 8.17 against the 7.7 threshold, artwork craft 6.5. Slides 08 (blurred lower band) and 09 (soft pillow terrain, QA ground-edge warn) are the weakest frames. Slide 08's list markers are drawn 30x3 px rules, not dash characters, but at a glance they read like dash bullets; consider squares or numerals next time. Section 224(d) is an approval step, not a veto; replies should not say veto. Section 229 is not claimed to bind Alaska's utilities. 'Names Alaska once' means one subsection (five lines, all in 224(d), per a full-text grep). The routine ran at effort medium although settings carry high.
